title: Team Lead SDR (m/w/d)
description:
WER WIR SIND

JUPUS baut die erste KI, die 80 % der Arbeit in Anwaltskanzleien selbstständig erledigt. Series A abgeschlossen. ARR 2025 vervierfacht. Über 2.000 Anwält*innen vertrauen JUPUS täglich ihre Mandate an.

In drei Jahren sind wir zu einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Legal Tech Unternehmen in Europa geworden - mit 90+ Mitarbeitenden in Köln und Berlin und einem international verteilten Tech-Team. Der Markt ist da. Das Produkt wirkt. Und wir stehen erst am Anfang.

Jetzt geht es darum, dieses Momentum in echte Marktbewegung zu übersetzen - und genau hier kommt diese Rolle ins Spiel.

Outbound ist bei JUPUS kein Nebenkanal. Es ist einer der zentralen Wachstumstreiber - und du wirst ihn anführen. Als Team Lead SDR hast du direkten Einfluss darauf, wie schnell JUPUS in den nächsten zwölf Monaten wächst.

 

WAS DICH ERWARTET

Du führst ein Team von 12-15 SDRs im operativen Alltag: coachen, Calls mithören, Feedback geben, Energie hochhalten.

Dabei geht es nicht nur darum, dass dein Team heute gute Meetings generiert. Deine Aufgabe ist es, aus starken SDRs die nächsten starken Account Executives bei JUPUS zu entwickeln.

Dafür arbeitest du eng mit dem AE-Team zusammen, entwickelst deine SDRs gezielt in Richtung Discovery, Einwandbehandlung und Closing weiter und sorgst dafür, dass sie Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung im Sales Cycle übernehmen können.

Viele Calls. Viele Neins. Und dann die Meetings, die den Unterschied machen.

Du weißt, wie das ist - und genau deshalb kannst du dein Team durch schwierige Tage führen, besser machen und auf den nächsten Karriereschritt vorbereiten.

 

DEINE AUFGABEN

- Team im Outbound-Alltag führen - Schlagzahl, Kontaktqualität und gebuchte Meetings als zentrale KPIs

- Calls mithören, direktes Feedback geben, Gesprächseinstieg und Einwandbehandlung praktisch vermitteln

- SDRs gezielt zu zukünftigen Account Executives entwickeln - gemeinsam mit dem AE-Team an Discovery, Einwandbehandlung und Closing arbeiten und sie Schritt für Schritt an den nächsten Karriereschritt heranführen

- Talk Tracks und Playbooks weiterentwickeln - nah an der Praxis, nicht am Whiteboard

- Neue SDRs schnell ins Doing bringen und für ein starkes Zusammenspiel zwischen SDR- und AE-Team sorgen

 

WAS DU MITBRINGST

- Echte SDR- oder BDR-Erfahrung - du kennst Kaltakquise aus eigener Praxis, nicht aus LinkedIn-Posts

- Erfahrung als Teamlead in der disziplinarischen Führung eines größeren SDR- oder BDR-Teams im High-Volume- und B2B-SaaS-Umfeld

- Hunter-Mentalität und die Fähigkeit, Energie ins Team zu bringen - auch wenn es mal zäh wird

- Deutsch auf Muttersprachler-Niveau

 

WAS DICH BEI UNS ERWARTET

- Wirkung ab Tag 1 - Outbound aktiv mitaufbauen und prägen

- Kurze Wege - direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Sales Leadership und Account Executives

- Flexibles Setup - Di-Do im Office , Rest flexibel

- Team & Benefits - Urban Sports, MacBook, Team-Events

 

KLINGT NACH DIR?

Kein perfektes Anschreiben nötig. Ein paar ehrliche Zeilen reichen.

Wir suchen keine lauten Egos - sondern Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen und andere wirklich besser machen wollen.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

• Raise experimentation standards: Guide best practices in A/B testing and causal inference in complex environments where traditional experimentation isn't always straightforward.

title: Applied Research Scientist, World Model
description:
About the team
Zillow has the richest housing market data in the industry. You help us build out a foundational model that leverages a representation of who is in the market, what they’ll pay, and how that demand clears against supply.

The Agentic Foundations team is a focused group of 15-20 applied scientists within Zillow’s broader Agentic AI organization, building the foundational AI technologies that power the next generation of home shopping experiences. This Principal Applied Scientist will help build the Zillow World Model: a single, uncertainty-aware model of the housing market that ties together supply, demand and macro conditions such as mortgage rates and policy. Today, bespoke models like Zestimate, Time-to-Pending and Listing Soon each answer one question well. The foundational “World” Model aims to answer the multi-step “what if” questions consumers actually ask, such as “If I list at $500K, when will it sell?” or “I want at least $800K; what should I list at?”, as consistent projections of one market state, and to serve those answers to Voyager, Zillow’s AI Mode, as a tool.

This is a very new field and an open-ended research effort. You will partner with the World Model working group (listing-state modeling, market simulation and evaluation) and with product, engineering, platform and data teams. Zillow observes both sides of the housing market at a depth no one else can, so this work can directly help guide users toward their goals. About the role

• Build the demand layer of the World Model: turn large-scale shopper behavior (search, engagement, session trajectories) into structured demand representations, including explicit attention-to-demand conversion.

• Design and train latent state-space, multi-tower and/or sequential dynamics models with calibrated uncertainty that support multi-step rollouts, forward planning (“if I do X, what happens?”) and backward planning (“I want X; what should I do?”).

• Estimate willingness-to-pay, per-home demand curves and market clearing dynamics, connecting learned representations to economic quantities.

• Apply causal identification in observational data and define where the model must abstain because a correlation does not support a “what-if” claim.

• Contribute to the World Model evaluation battery: state probes, calibrated multi-target forecasts, rollout drift, causal checks and out-of-regime replays.

• Independently drive ambiguous research end-to-end, and provide technical leadership and mentorship in translating state-of-the-art research into production impact.

description:
About Bedrock
Bedrock Facility Solutions helps companies with multiple locations manage repairs, maintenance, service providers, assets, and facility activity across their properties. Pebble, our facility management platform, keeps work orders, communication, estimates, invoices, response times, and location history organized.
The Role
We are hiring a Facility Services Coordinator to help manage the daily flow of service requests.
A repair request can quickly involve a client, a service provider, an estimate, photos, approvals, scheduling, and several follow ups. Your job is to keep that work organized and make sure everyone knows what is happening next.
You will receive service requests, document the right information, assign approved service providers, track their progress, and communicate with clients until the work is completed. You do not need to be a technician, but you should be comfortable learning basic facility and trade terminology.
This is not just a data entry position. Clients and service providers will rely on you to pay attention, communicate clearly, and follow through.
What You Will Do

• Receive service requests through Pebble, phone, and email

• Confirm the location, issue, urgency, access instructions, and other important details

• Create and update accurate work orders in Pebble

• Assign approved service providers based on trade, location, availability, and urgency

• Confirm acceptance and estimated arrival times

• Keep clients updated from the initial request through completion

• Monitor open work orders and follow up when progress stalls

• Escalate emergencies, delays, service problems, and approval issues

• Coordinate estimates and confirm that required approvals are received before work begins

• Collect completion notes, photos, invoices, and other supporting documentation

• Help schedule preventive maintenance and recurring services

• Work with customer success, billing, and operations to resolve questions

• Participate in a rotating evening or weekend coverage schedule when assigned

What We Are Looking For

• At least two years of experience in facilities coordination, maintenance dispatch, property management, service operations, customer service, or a similar role

• Strong phone, email, and written communication

• Good judgment when determining urgency and next steps

• The ability to stay organized while managing several open requests

• Consistent follow through without needing repeated reminders

• Comfort speaking with clients and service providers throughout the day

• Experience with a work order system, CMMS, dispatch platform, property management system, or CRM is helpful

• Basic familiarity with HVAC, plumbing, electrical, locksmith, janitorial, landscaping, or general maintenance is helpful

• Ability to work remotely with reliable internet and a quiet place for client calls

• Ability to participate in scheduled after hours coverage

A college degree is not required.
What Matters at Bedrock
Put the client first. Stay calm when something goes wrong. Be honest about delays or problems. Take responsibility and follow through.
This is a full time W2 position. The position is paid hourly and is eligible for overtime in accordance with applicable law.
